03

The NFT lens

A bigger slice.
Not a bigger pool.

An eligible Ascend NFT changes a holder’s weighting inside the direct HYPE reward pool. It does not enlarge that pool and does not boost ecosystem-token distributions.

Verify in the Ascend NFT docs ↗
